title: Maradona & Pelé
description: Two icons who defined the World Cup — test your legend knowledge.

questions.q: How many World Cups did Pelé win with Brazil?
Pelé became the youngest World Cup winner in 1958 at what age?
questions.explain: He was 17 and scored twice in the final.

questions.q: Maradona captained Argentina to the title in which year?
questions.explain: He led Argentina to the 1986 trophy in Mexico.

questions.q: Maradona's 'Hand of God' and 'Goal of the Century' both came against whom?
questions.explain: Both came in the 1986 quarter-final against England.
Pelé is Brazil's most iconic footballer.

questions.q: Maradona's Argentina lost the 1990 final to which team?
Pelé scored in the final of which World Cup as a teenager?
questions.explain: He scored twice in the 1958 final against Sweden.

questions.q: Diego Maradona represented which national team?
questions.explain: Maradona is Argentina's most celebrated player.
